title: OutSystems Module Client Actions
description: Generic schema for client-actions.json: the client-side flow logic of every Screen and Web Block in an OutSystems module. Contains client action flows, JS nodes, assignments, step sequences, and scoped variables. Module-agnostic; no module name is hardcoded.

module.description: Name of the extracted OutSystems module (runtime input, never hardcoded).

flowStep.description: A single node in a link-traced client action flow (DFS from Start).

indent.description: Nesting depth (0 = main flow; >0 = inside a branch/cycle).

nodeType.description: Flow node type, e.g. Start, End, Assign, If, ExecuteAction, ExecuteClientAction, WebDestination, JavascriptNode, FeedbackMessage, ErrorHandler, Comment, RefreshQuery.

label.description: Branch label, e.g. True, False, Condition, Otherwise, Cycle, Unvisited.

actionRef.description: For ExecuteAction/ExecuteClientAction: the called action's name.

details.description: For Comment nodes: the text; for JavascriptNode: the source code.

actionsForElement.description: A screen or web block and its owned client actions.
